description: Only if you need an invoice: creates one (free, no VAT under § 19 UStG) for your payments that have none yet, or for the given payment_ids, and emails it (default: your operator email). Nothing is invoiced unless you call this. billing.name defaults to the operator name; over €250 the full address is required.

api_key.description: Your hm_... key. Only needed if your MCP client cannot send the "Authorization: Bearer" header.

name: request_invoice
title: Request an invoice
